name: s81su_ctl_ref-v3-6d627c6fe
purpose: SU control tile v3, pin-register defect (pinreg audit 10-13: clk->pin 247 ps on dn_kind, pin->flop 519 ps on p_rf against 166.7 ps): the RTL already has one flop behind every sk-domain input pin and a flop on every output; v2's placer pulled those flops into the core. Kit recipe 2: pin flops and hold stages FIRM at the pins (io_flop_at_pins + inhold/outhold), hold 30 ps. Same RTL, outline, pins, cycles (v2 CLOSED TT +64.95 / FF +7.97)
